_README: Label id -> structure of the femoral neurovascular bundle tracked in the female's full-resolution cryosections (scripts/cryo/vhf_femoral_track.py + vhf_nerve_volume.py). A KEY, not data.
Right side only; the masks are vessel LUMINA, not walls.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), female cryosections at full resolution (0.33 mm) via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. Derived data (scripts/cryo/vhf_femoral_track.py).
